summary: Completed live API and responsive UI regression testing for the Aman portfolio. All executed core flows passed, including inquiry submission, navigation, private contact modal, asset loading, content visibility, privacy checks, and mobile overflow checks.

minor.issue: InquiryCreate accepts any string as email; API-level email format validation is missing even though the browser input uses type=email.

integration_issues.issue: Links are external but point to generic https://www.linkedin.com and https://github.com homepages rather than Aman’s profile URLs; verify and replace with the supplied resume profile destinations.

action_items: Replace generic LinkedIn/GitHub destinations with Aman’s actual profile URLs.
Add Pydantic EmailStr (and the required dependency/configuration) or equivalent server-side email validation for POST /api/inquiries.
critical_code_review_comments: Social links currently satisfy external-link presence but do not identify Aman’s profiles, so this is a functional content integration risk.
Server-side inquiry validation should not rely only on browser-native type=email validation.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ inquiry and TEST_status_regression records through public API for regression checks; no seeded production records were modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Core desktop/mobile portfolio flows are covered and passing. Recheck actual social profile destinations and invalid-email API behavior after fixes.
rca of the issue: The social-link issue originates from hardcoded generic homepage URLs in App.js rather than resume-specific profile URLs. Inquiry email weakness originates from InquiryCreate.email being typed as plain str in server.py; browser validation does not protect direct API callers.
